phases.title: Survival
phases.goal: Read the Devanagari script and handle greetings, numbers and the most basic needs.
can: Recognise and sound out all Devanagari vowels (अ आ इ ई...) and core consonants
Read simple words with matras (vowel signs) like पानी, नमस्ते, किताब
Greet and introduce yourself: नमस्ते, मेरा नाम... है, आप कैसे हैं?
Count 1–100 and say prices and phone numbers
Use को/मुझे to say what you want or need: मुझे पानी चाहिए
Ask the survival questions यह कितने का है? and शौचालय कहाँ है?
phases.daily: 15 min tracing Devanagari letters, 10 min number/greeting flashcards, 5 min listening to a beginner Hindi dialogue and repeating aloud.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: Build correct present-tense sentences with gender agreement and postpositions.
can: Assign masculine/feminine gender and make adjectives agree (अच्छा लड़का / अच्छी लड़की)
Form the habitual present with -ता/ती/ते + हूँ/है/हैं
Use postpositions में, पर, से, को after nouns instead of prepositions
Ask questions with क्या and the words कौन, कहाँ, कब, क्यों, कैसे
Negate correctly with नहीं and command with मत
Choose between आप, तुम and तू for the right level of respect
phases.daily: 20 min conjugation and gender drills, 10 min building 5 SOV sentences of your own, 10 min shadowing audio to fix pronunciation of retroflex ट/ड and nasal sounds.

phases.title: Core Structures
phases.goal: Handle past and future time and the ने construction in real conversation.
can: Talk about the past with था/थी/थे and the habitual -ता था form
Use the ergative ने construction so the verb agrees with the object
Form the future tense with -गा/गी/गे endings
Apply the oblique case (लड़का→लड़के, plurals in -ओं) before postpositions
Express obligation and ability with चाहिए, सकना and पड़ना
Describe ongoing and completed actions with रहा है and चुका है
phases.daily: 20 min narrating yesterday and tomorrow aloud, 15 min ने-sentence drills, 15 min reading graded stories and underlining every postposition and case change.

phases.title: Fluency
phases.goal: Link ideas smoothly and hold everyday conversations with connectors and clauses.
can: Join actions with the conjunctive participle कर/के (खाकर, जाकर)
Build relative–correlative sentences with जो...वह and जहाँ...वहाँ
Use conditionals अगर...तो for real and hypothetical situations
Compare and rank things with से, ज़्यादा and सबसे
Add nuance with compound verbs like खा लेना, दे देना, सो जाना
Handle real tasks: bargaining, directions, booking tickets, seeing a doctor
phases.daily: 25 min conversation or self-talk on a daily topic, 15 min watching a Hindi show with Devanagari subtitles, 10 min journaling a few sentences using a new connector each day.

phases.title: Mastery
phases.goal: Use subtle, register-appropriate Hindi and understand native media with ease.
can: Use the subjunctive for wishes, doubt and politeness (शायद वह आए, मैं जाऊँ?)
Handle the passive voice and impersonal statements (हिंदी बोली जाती है)
Command causative verbs across layers (खिलाना, कटवाना, करवाना)
Switch register between formal, literary and colloquial Hindi appropriately
Recognise common Urdu-origin and Sanskrit-origin vocabulary and idioms
Follow films, news and literature and discuss abstract topics fluently
phases.daily: 30 min native podcasts or news without subtitles, 20 min reading a novel or newspaper column, 10 min noting idioms and shades of register to reuse in your own speech and writing.
